issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies the Lecture attributes as private, but the template declares some attributes as public. The solution implements the attributes as private. This visibility mismatch between the problem statement/solution and the template can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and whether they should add getters/setters or expose fields directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture.java to match the visibility shown in the UML and the solution: declare the attributes as private (private String lectureName; private int numberOfInscribedStudents; private int numberOfGuestStudents; private int numberOfLecturers; private int numberOfTutors;) and provide the expected getters/setters in the template stubs. This aligns the template with the specification and avoids student confusion about encapsulation.
